performance.verdict: Lead spike is real but scale-up gate still blocked by 9 overdue milestones.

findings.text: CPL collapsed 86.88% in 7 days (from ~$700 baseline to ~$91.55/28d avg) driven by Google Ads spend surging 195.25%; efficiency gain is real but fragile — Google spend spiked to $198.89 on 10/02 then dropped to $0 on 10/03–10/04.

9 SOW milestones are overdue as of today: Booking bot battle-test (due 7/31), Intake owner confirmed (8/31), Review Boost campaign (8/31), Financing page (8/31), Homer Glen branch (8/31), LSA re-enable (9/1), Heating/furnace content indexed (9/30), Fall creative package (9/30), Heating campaigns live (10/1) — all unresolved, blocking scale-up gate.

3-day signal (10/03–10/05) vs prior 3 days (09/30–10/02): leads dropped from 11 to 1, spend collapsed from $292.93 to $119.57, and Google spend went $0 on 10/03 and 10/04 — a confirmed short-term reversal after the spike.

GHL shows 1,599 opportunities created vs only 55 won and 0 appointments in 28 days — with intake owner unconfirmed since 7/7, leads are likely arriving but not being worked; this is an intake leak, not an ads problem.

Quality HVAC Solutions GBP call rate is 1.47% on 954 impressions (14 calls in 28 days) vs Fibid profile at 5.11% on 176 impressions — the higher-traffic profile converts at 3.5x worse rate, suggesting listing content or CTA gap.

suggestions.text: Confirm intake owner and GHL login — unblocks scale-up gate and stops confirmed lead-to-opp leak with 1,599 opps vs 55 won.
suggestions.monday_update: Vivian (dispatch) left 7/7 and intake ownership is unconfirmed, blocking all budget scale-up per SOW gate. GHL shows 1,599 opportunities created against only 55 won and 0 appointments — speed-to-lead automations may be pointing at an empty seat. Confirm who owns intake, verify their GHL login, and document after-hours coverage. Success check: intake owner named and GHL login active by 2026-10-10.

suggestions.text: Watch Google Ads spend continuity — $0 spend on 10/03 and 10/04 after $198.89 spike; confirm campaign is active before any budget action.
suggestions.monday_update: Google Ads spend dropped to $0 on 10/03 and 10/04 after a $198.89 peak on 10/02, and only $57.80 returned on 10/05. This is a 3-day confirmed reversal signal that needs explanation before any scale action. Check campaign status, budget caps, and whether the LocalServicesCampaign ($459.55 in 28d) is still active and approved. Success check: 3 consecutive days of consistent spend confirmed by 2026-10-09.

suggestions.text: Optimize Quality HVAC Solutions GBP listing CTA — 1.47% call rate on 954 impressions vs 5.11% on Fibid profile; close the conversion gap.
suggestions.monday_update: The Quality HVAC Solutions GBP profile generated 954 impressions over 26 days but only 14 calls — a 1.47% call rate versus the Fibid profile's 5.11% on far fewer impressions. Review and update the primary category, services listed, call-to-action button, and photo set on the Solutions profile to match what is working on the Fibid profile. Success check: call rate on Solutions profile rises above 3% within the next 28-day window, checked on 2026-11-03.
